findings.claim: The thread screenshot can be taken before the later block-producing SSE events render, so it does not reliably satisfy the “every block type” screenshot requirement.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.2 requires the captured thread conversation to include every block type, but `streamFixtureConversation` waits only for `FIXTURE_FINAL_TEXT`; in `e2e/fixtures/sse.ts`, `FIXTURE_FINAL_TEXT` is emitted in the message deltas before subsequent `agui.memory.mutation`, `agui.artifact`, `agui.artifact_input_request`, `agui.custom`, and `agui.done` events.
findings.suggested_fix: Wait for a marker from the last required rendered block, such as the A2UI/custom artifact or another post-`agui.done` visible sentinel, before expanding/capturing the thread.

findings.claim: `npm run test:a11y` is not portable to all developer machines because it uses the POSIX-only `rm -rf` shell command.
findings.evidence: The capability says the harness runs identically on any developer machine or CI runner, while the `test:a11y` script is `rm -rf test-results/a11y && playwright test e2e/a11y.spec.ts; ...`, which fails on Windows shells without Unix tools.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the shell cleanup with a Node script using `fs.rmSync('test-results/a11y', { recursive: true, force: true })`, or use a cross-platform cleanup utility.
